title: The Fernling at Dusk

setting.mapIntent: A brief meeting on Sunlit Trail, where a traveler pauses beside their familiar Fernling.
placementConstraints: Use the existing Sunlit Trail map.
Keep the traveler and Fernling together in one quiet, accessible spot; no movement choreography.
The chest is optional and can be approached independently of the conversation.

participants.identity: A road-worn traveler in a patched green coat, carrying a rolled bedroll and a heavy pack.
participants.role: A friendly stranger with a small puzzle about the trail's evening hush.
participants.startingSituation: Standing still on the trail beside their familiar Fernling; available for a short conversation.

participants.identity: Fernling, a small green fox with leaf-shaped ears and a broad leafy tail.
participants.role: The traveler's familiar companion, present as a quiet witness to the conversation.
participants.startingSituation: Resting beside the traveler. It does not move or speak during this scene.

beats.intent: The traveler welcomes the player and introduces the unusual quiet of the trail.
beats.speaker: Traveler
beats.text: Evening. This little one usually wakes at every rustle, but tonight it keeps listening to the hill.

beats.intent: The traveler shares a gentle, unresolved mystery without claiming a supernatural event.
beats.speaker: Traveler
beats.text: Fernling heard a second set of footsteps after mine stopped. I looked back; the path was empty. Maybe the wind has learned our pace.

beats.intent: The traveler takes comfort from their familiar's steady presence and leaves the mystery open.
beats.speaker: Traveler
beats.text: There, a tail flick. That's its way of saying we should keep walking together. Safe trails to you, friend.

beats.intent: Allow the player to inspect and open the existing treasure chest if they choose.
beats.interactionIntent: Interact with the treasure chest on Sunlit Trail.
beats.expectedResult: The existing chest interaction offers its authored coins, potions, or orbs reward once; this optional interaction does not gate the conversation.
